findings.description: reserve_order reserves lines one at a time. If a later line raises UnknownSku or OutOfStock, the earlier lines stay reserved. place_order then returns 404 or 409, so the client sees a failed order while stock for the earlier lines is held and never released. The old code checked every line before reserving any, so this change introduces the leak.
findings.suggestion: Validate all lines first (check each SKU exists and has enough available stock), then apply the reservations. Alternatively, roll back the reservations already made when an exception occurs, using release.
findings.title: reserve_order is not atomic: partial reservations leak on failure
